reviews.title: My advice Do not purchase the yearly subscription
reviews.text:
I purchased the discounted annual VIP subscription while my weekly VIP subscription was still active, expecting the annual membership to take effect automatically once the weekly subscription ended.

Unfortunately, that never happened. As soon as my weekly subscription expired, the app marked my VIP membership as expired, even though Apple clearly confirms that my annual subscription is active and valid until October 17, 2027.

I have effectively paid for a full year of VIP access but cannot access the content I purchased. Instead, the app continues to prompt me to subscribe again.

This is particularly frustrating because the problem appears to be related to how the app handles the transition from a weekly to an annual subscription. Customers should not lose access to a service they have already paid for simply because they upgraded their subscription before the previous billing period ended.

I tried the in app supports and sending emails, but no single respond

I hope the development team takes this issue seriously, improves subscription synchronization, and provides proper customer support to resolve these cases.

reviews.title: Misleading promotion, Poor Customer service & Questionable Content
reviews.text: I joined this app because it was running a biweekly promotion for $9.99, but it tuned out the promotional price was only valid for one week. I tried contacting customer service but on one ever responded. I eventually left a message, and instead of acknowledging the issue, the team simply suggested that I cancel the membership myself. Beyond the customer service problems, I also noticed issues with the content. Some shorts were published without proper endings, while others reused the same story in different shorts or formats. More concerningly, many of the ai-generated movies appear to have significant copyright issues. You can clearly hear or see elements copied from famous movies without any credit or acknowledgment. Overall, I’m very disappointed with both the customer service and the quality of the originality of the content. I do not recommend this app.

Read the fine print and it states that if I delete my account but the automatic renewal is still active, they’re not responsible for future charges. The “cancel auto-renewal” option in the Manage Subscription page is for show. After selecting it, nothing changes. What’s suspicious is that the subscription does not show on my Apple account and so I’m unable to unsubscribe through there either but I still somehow get charged each week. Submitted a fraud complaint.

reviews.title: Quality Has Dropped Dramatically
reviews.text:
⭐⭐☆☆☆ (2 Stars)

I bought a yearly membership because I genuinely enjoyed NetShort. Unfortunately, shortly after I subscribed, it feels like the platform shifted heavily toward AI-generated content, and the difference in quality has been dramatic.

Some of these dramas have become almost unwatchable. Characters suddenly change from Asian to white and then back again. Faces, hairstyles, and even clothing change from one shot to the next. Voices and accents switch in the middle of a sentence as if a completely different actor took over. Sometimes the same character appears to be played by two different people in the same scene.

The editing is even worse. Entire scenes feel like they’re stitched together from different stories. Plot lines disappear without explanation, new characters appear out of nowhere, and continuity is so broken that it becomes difficult to follow what’s happening. Instead of watching one story, it often feels like two or three unrelated dramas have been spliced together.

I’m not against AI. AI can be a great tool when it’s used well. My problem is the lack of quality control. If you’re going to use AI, someone still needs to review the final product before it’s released. Right now, many of these shows are so incoherent that they actually give you a headache trying to follow them.

The older content showed that NetShort could produce entertaining dramas. I hope the company slows down, focuses on quality instead of quantity, and fixes these issues because
